title: FarmingOutlook (F2 farmland, F3 crops, F4 decisions)
description: v0.4, reviewed by lane A. Served by GET /api/farming?country=EGY from ml/outputs/farming_<ISO>.json. Written today by python ml/farming.py (FAO ECOCROP calculator); a trained model replaces it by writing the same file. Check a file with: python run.py farming-check. Flat arrays use index k = i * ncols + j, row i from the south, column j from the west, and have nrows * ncols values. 'required' lists every field the app reads without a fallback today, so a file that passes the check cannot crash the Crops, Farmland or Decisions tabs.

score_grid.description: One value per cell: integer 0 to 100 (100 = ideal), null outside the country.

number_grid.description: One value per cell, null where there is none.

per_crop_scores.description: crop id -> one score_grid per horizon, in the order of 'horizons'.

per_mode_per_crop.description: mode (irrigated, rainfed) -> crop id -> one grid.

method.description: One sentence describing the model, shown in the app.

horizons.description: The three years behind the app's Now / 2030 / 2035 buttons, e.g. [2025, 2030, 2035].

inside.description: One character per cell: 1 = the cell touches the country.

evidence.description: One character per cell: strength of the warming trend (S strong, M moderate, N not proven, - no data).

suitable_threshold.description: Score at which a crop 'fits' a place.

years_to_heat_limit.description: crop id -> grid of years until the crop gets too hot (99 = safe, null = not applicable). A model without this idea writes null for every cell.

suitability_10_low.description: Optional: last horizon, low end of the uncertainty.

suitability_10_high.description: Optional: last horizon, high end of the uncertainty.

best_start_month.description: Optional: 0 = January, start of the best season now.
